page.overview:
Who is Pete Harkins?

Commander Pete Harkins was a Human Starfleet officer. He had a wife named Angie and a sister-in-law named Hope, who resided in Boston.

Harkins was in charge of the Pathfinder Project at Starfleet's Communications Research Center from 2376 to 2377, reporting directly to Admiral Owen Paris. Lieutenant Reginald Barclay was part of his team. (; )

During this time, Harkins took a liking to Barclay, and tried to pair him with Hope at one point. () Harkins also offered for him to stay at a beach house in Malaysia, which was owned by a cousin of his. ()

Harkins, as Barclay's boss, respected his ingenuity and hard work ethic, but often felt he had to bring him back down to reality. He initially discouraged Barclay's odd theories about contacting the , preferring to concentrate on a plan in partnership with the Vulcans. With little in the way of concrete proof, he refused to allow Barclay to discuss the matter with Paris. Additionally, he believed that Barclay was spending too much time in a holo-simulation of Voyager and its crew, and was having a relapse of his holo-addiction. Harkins had to order Barclay to counseling and remove him from the project. Harkins even ordered a security team to arrest Barclay when he broke into the MIDAS array. Barclay, however, later proved his theories were correct and successfully established regular communications with Voyager. ()
